title: cleistes gracilis
intro: Cleistes gracilis, commonly known as the slender slipper orchid, is a species of orchid in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Cleistes gracilis include its antihypertensive, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cleistes gracilis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
